name: GEO paper (Aggarwal et al.) and related research
notes: Foundational paper of the field (KDD 2024), with the GEO-bench benchmark. Follow-up work to watch: E-GEO (2511.20867), GEO16 (2509.10762), product-visibility manipulation (2404.07981). 2509.08919 is a vendor-linked working paper, not peer reviewed. Code: github.com/GEO-optim/GEO.

name: Google Search Central — AI features documentation and AI optimization guide
notes: Official documentation on AI Overviews and AI Mode (grounding, query fan-out) and on optimization, including a mythbusting section. Second page: developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide. No feed: check the pages for changes.

name: Google Search Central Blog
notes: Official announcements on Search features, Search Console metrics and publisher controls for AI features.

name: The Keyword — Google Search blog
notes: Corporate product announcements for Search. Usage figures are company-stated: treat them as announcements, not independent metrics.

name: Perplexity — Changelog and Hub
notes: Near-weekly changelog; longer posts at perplexity.ai/hub/blog. Citation-grounded answer engine.

name: OpenAI — News and Developers Blog
notes: Official announcements on ChatGPT search and usage. Also developers.openai.com/blog. The feed covers all OpenAI news: keep search-related posts only.

name: arXiv — cs.IR, cs.CL, cs.AI, cs.LG
notes: Preprints, feed updated daily, very high volume. Filter for: generative engine optimization, answer engine, AI Overviews, citation, LLM search visibility.

name: Semantic Scholar — papers citing the GEO paper
notes: Meta-source for new research citing the GEO paper. Free API: api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/arXiv:2311.09735/citations.

name: Microsoft Advertising — blog (Copilot and Bing generative search)
notes: Guidance on how Copilot and Bing retrieve and assess content. Mix of primary information and marketing.

name: Awesome-GEO (curated research list)
notes: Curated list of GEO research papers. Watch new commits.

name: Anthropic — News
notes: Announcements on Claude, including web search with citations. Tool documentation: platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool.

name: Search Engine Journal — AI search coverage
notes: Trade publication with a news team and expert contributors; strong on engine and vendor news. The feed covers the whole site and holds only about three days of posts: keep AI search posts only and cover the rest of the window with a site search.

name: Semrush — blog, newsroom and AI Visibility Index
notes: Large-scale studies on AI citations and visibility; AI Visibility Index at ai-visibility-index.semrush.com, updated monthly. Vendor (an Adobe company): weigh for commercial interest.

name: Search Engine Land — GEO / AI SEO
notes: Leading trade publication with a dedicated GEO / AI SEO hub. Owned by Semrush. Feed and article pages return 403 to the fetch tool (November 2026): cover through search, and use other coverage of the same story when an article cannot be opened.

name: iPullRank — blog, The Rank Report, The AI Search Manual
notes: Among the most technical sources on retrieval in answer engines (query fan-out, passage retrieval, embeddings). Agency: commercial interest in framing AI search as a new discipline.

name: Ahrefs Blog — AI search studies
notes: Recurring data studies on AI visibility based on the Brand Radar dataset. Vendor: weigh for commercial interest.

name: Growth Memo — Kevin Indig
notes: Independent analyst newsletter with original research (usability studies, clickstream analyses). Some issues are sponsored (for example by Semrush): note sponsorship when it bears on a finding.

name: SparkToro — blog
notes: Annual zero-click study with Datos/Similarweb and related research. Independent counterweight to vendor data.

name: Aleyda Solis — SEOFOMO and LearningAIsearch
notes: Weekly newsletter curating search and AI search news; free roadmap at learningaisearch.com. Strong on AI crawler crawlability.

name: Amsive — AI search research (Lily Ray)
notes: Original research on which brands AI engines cite; explicitly anti-hype. Counterweight to vendor content.

name: Moz — blog and Moz Top 10
notes: SEO blog with growing AI search coverage; Moz Top 10 is a curated biweekly newsletter. moz.com cannot be fetched by the run's tools (November 2026): cover through search.

name: Profound — blog and research
notes: Category-leading AI visibility vendor: proprietary data and format experiments. Weigh for commercial interest.

name: Peec AI — blog
notes: Mid-market AI visibility tracking vendor. Weigh for commercial interest.
